record.original_question: For subcubic graphs, do the following stronger strong-edge-coloring bounds hold: first, if G is bridgeless and has more than 13 vertices, then chi_s(G) <= 8; second, if G has girth at least 5, then chi_s(G) <= 7?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 32. Let G be a subcubic graph. ... (b) [141] If G is bridgeless and |V (G)| > 13, then χ_s(G) 6 8. (c) [141] If G has girth at least 5, then χ_s(G) 6 7.

Let G be a subcubic graph. If G is bridgeless and |V (G)| > 13, then χ_s(G) 6 8. If G has girth at least 5, then χ_s(G) 6 7. These are Conjecture 32(b,c), due to Luˇzar, Maˇcajov´a, Skoviera, and Sot´ak.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A graph is subcubic if every vertex has degree at most 3. A strong edge coloring of a graph G is a proper edge coloring in which no two edges with the same color are joined by another edge; equivalently, every color class is an induced matching. The strong chromatic index χ_s(G) is the smallest number of colors in a strong edge coloring of G. A bridge is an edge whose deletion increases the number of connected components, and G is bridgeless if it has no bridges. The girth of G is the length of a shortest cycle in G.

Prove or disprove the following two statements about subcubic graphs G:

(a) If G is bridgeless and has more than 13 vertices, then χ_s(G) ≤ 8.

(b) If G has girth at least 5, then χ_s(G) ≤ 7.
artifact.category_tag: Strong edge coloring of subcubic graphs
artifact.status_search_result: The two conjectured bounds (χ_s ≤ 8 for bridgeless subcubic graphs on more than 13 vertices, and χ_s ≤ 7 for subcubic graphs of girth at least 5) are stated as open conjectures in recent literature on strong edge coloring of subcubic graphs (e.g., Lužar–Mačajová–Škoviera–Soták 2022 and the 2024 work on list strong/normal edge-coloring of subcubic graphs). No proof of either statement was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Strong edge colorings of graphs and the covers of Kneser graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Authors propose and discuss strong edge coloring conjectures for cubic and subcubic graphs related to Kneser graph covers.
status_evidence.claim: The conjectures of Lužar–Mačajová–Škoviera–Soták on strong edge colorings of subcubic graphs are discussed without proofs of the (b),(c) parts.

status_evidence.title: List strong and list normal edge-coloring of (sub)cubic graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on strong edge-coloring of subcubic graphs referencing open conjectures, including bounds for bridgeless subcubic graphs and graphs of girth at least 5.
status_evidence.claim: The bounds χ_s ≤ 8 (bridgeless, |V|>13) and χ_s ≤ 7 (girth ≥ 5) for subcubic graphs are still discussed as open conjectures in 2024 literature.
